text: Spaceship’s original interface. Local Qwen2.5 through llama.cpp. Actual-speed recording.
Drag the main knob forward: first the opening, then the generated continuation.
Select “roses”. Its attention lock adds +2 to the selected word’s model keys.
Reveal more of the regenerated future. The lock stays attached as the cursor moves.
Move the lock onto “engine”. Dragging changes the actual weighted key positions.
Double-click the main knob to release locks. Double-click again to discover measured attention.
Hover the locks and inspect the left rail: final-layer attention averaged across heads.
Double-click and hold the main knob, then pull out a fan control.
The fan names a story word. Turn left to suppress attention to that word.
Bring the control closer: distance reduces the strength of the intervention.
Now turn right and move outward: amplify the same word more strongly.
Scrub backward and rest. Spaceship discards the buffered future and generates a new branch.
Move forward again to read the new continuation under the current attention settings.
Release all attached controls, then explore another continuation with the original scrubber.
Same Spaceship UI. Real attention bias and measured attention. No added steering instructions.
